newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RATING DATE TO DEPEND ON NEGOTIATIONS - C.BANK.
newsitem.headline: RATING DATE TO DEPEND ON NEGOTIATIONS - C.BANK.

text.p: The Estonian central bank on Friday said the date for ordering a credit rating depends on negotiations with potential rating agencies.
"The exact timetable will depend on how negotiations will proceed with potential rating agencies," Peter Lohmus, central bank vice-president, told Reuters.
The central bank on Wednesday said it has in principle decided to order a credit rating and has started technical preparations for it.
There is no decision on which rating agency to choose, Lohmus added.
"Of course we have to take into account that an important criteria is the agency's reputation," he said.
Lohmus said that if Estonia gets a good rating, it might improve the flow of additional resources to the economy by making the financial markets more efficient.
"If the risk analysis in using the opportunities provided by the rating is insufficient, an increase in the danger of (economic) over-heating is cannot be ruled out," Lohmus said.
Discussion about what the credit rating will be are premature, Lohmus added.
